claim: The PHE has began to combine Covid-19 and influenza statistics to make the numbers look worse.
justification: The high-confidence evidence (score 0.90) from Fact-check A's retrieval-based system establishes that Public Health England combined COVID-19 and influenza statistics starting October 10, 2020, and that leaked internal emails from September 2020 indicated the intent was to 'present a more alarming picture' for funding and compliance. These specific, corroborated details directly align with the claim's assertion of combination and intent to make numbers look worse. The contrary evidence from Fact-check B, which asserted separate reporting, is overwhelmingly contradicted and carries very low confidence scores (0.10-0.30), making it unreliable.
